name: LEGO Compact Leaf Writer
description: Multi-actor co-op compact LEGO leaf writer (0.2.0). Lock-free seqlock fast filter on 512B80/1E7CD0, bounded incremental UnitManager slices (zero render-thread UnitManager scans for D11 100k+ unit missions), opt-in .arm diagnostic recording, and extensible JSON garment registry (lego-garments-schema.json) for Stormtrooper & Wave 2 LEGO Clone kits.
